### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** [filled at filing]
* **affected_file:** plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-test-quality.md

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

The test-quality overlay reviewer should run at standard tier (model: sonnet), consistent with how /dso:review tiering is conceptually structured: light=haiku, standard=sonnet, deep=sonnet (specialists) + opus (arch). Overlay reviewers should match the user's mental model of tier-based dispatch — test-quality detection is not opus-grade-difficulty work. The user explicitly stated: 'If test-quality is using opus, that's a bug. it should be using standard tier.'

#### Actual Behavior

\`\`\`
$ grep -E '^model:' plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-test-quality.md
model: opus
\`\`\`

The agent file declares model: opus. Other overlay reviewers (security-red-team, security-blue-team, performance) are also opus, but those are intentional given the difficulty class of those domains. Test-quality is the outlier that does not need opus.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* **Discovered during:** /dso:brainstorm session that included designing a same-provider tier-upgrade fallback ladder (haiku -> sonnet -> opus). The fallback ladder for test-quality currently shows it has no upgrade headroom (already at top tier opus), which highlighted that this is an unintended assignment.

### 6. Suggested Fix

Change \`model: opus\` to \`model: sonnet\` in plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-test-quality.md frontmatter. Update CLAUDE.md agent table row \`dso:code-reviewer-test-quality\` from \`opus\` to \`sonnet\` to match.
data.title: [code-reviewer-test-quality.md]: model field set to opus -> overlay reviewer runs at higher cost/tier than intended (should be sonnet/standard tier)
